title: Cistercian 1657: complete two-form Pater and unresolved wider post-Canon source damage

accepted_constituent.title: Cistercian missal 1657: Pater noster in its two chant forms
accepted_constituent.scope: Complete functional Pater constituent in offered source order: FIDES page-file 0275 (printed p.213), right column from Orémus after the earlier Canon/Iungit manus, through the introduction and adjacent Extendit manus; all page-file 0276 (printed p.214) body text, including the first complete Pater and response/Amen, the governing alternative-cantus rubric for three-lesson feasts, ferial days and Masses for the dead, the separately printed Per omnia/Amen and second introduction/Pater; and page-file 0277 (printed p.215), left column through Sacerdos submissâ voce dicit / Amén. It stops before the right-column Deinde accipit Patenam and Libera nos. Both complete printed chant forms and all governing rubrics are included. Final Amén. preserves the independently preferred probable printed acute over e in a worn/folded area; the hooked mark meets a crease, so that diacritic retains an explicit source-condition reservation. This complete declared functional constituent has partial whole-book and partial post-Canon text coverage. The wider continuation through page-file 0285 remains blocked by concealed source letters and punctuation; no alternate-setting words fill those gaps.

bounded_alternative_outcome.outcome: Original title verifies Paris Cramoisy 1657 imprint. The selected prayer page visibly reads293 and differs in setting from FIDES printed215. Bibliographic/body relationship remains unresolved. No concealed FIDES letters, accents or punctuation are transferred.
bounded_alternative_outcome.negative_limit: A bounded inspected different-setting witness does not prove that no same-setting alternate survives.

reopening_conditions: Acquire or locate a lawful same-setting original delivery that visibly exposes each concealed FIDES span; establish exact setting and locus before any reading transfer.
Alternatively obtain source-repair imaging of the same FIDES copy that reveals the covered letters and punctuation.
Keep the complete functional Pater separate from the wider unaccepted post-Canon until every intervening source block has independent literal and extent review.

retention_scope.limit: Exact native bytes used for this thirteen-page source review are retained or reused. Earlier acquisition of 740 offered page files is not inspection of all 740 pages or complete physical-volume proof. Modern wrappers, response headers and transient signed routes are excluded from public payloads.

preservation.comparison_limit: Only the accepted complete Pater overlap may support a parallel text comparison with 1606. Later untranscribed 1657 prayers are not absent merely because this binding stops before Libera.
